checks: All five APITube units claim independently in the same cycle.
Concurrent scheduled and manual stock attempts respect the active lease.
A failed stock job waits for the retry backoff.
Only failed stocks can take their second attempt without rerunning other units.
A stale lease cannot finish the current stock attempt.
Scheduled attempts are capped at two per job per cycle.
Successful general and industry jobs remain skipped during a stock failure.
A new cycle resets the attempt count; a successful stock retry becomes idempotent.
